description: This source file defines FastAPI routes related to 'roles' in a role management system. It provides endpoints to list all roles and retrieve details for a specific role, including required skills and levels.

classes.name: RoleOut
classes.description: Pydantic schema for role output with id, name, description.

classes.name: RoleDetail
classes.description: Detailed role information including required skills.

classes.name: SkillRequirement
classes.description: Schema for skill requirement with skill id, name, and required level.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET /roles to list all roles with their basic info.

methods.name: RoleDetail get_role(role_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET /roles/{role_id} to retrieve detailed info about a specific role including required skills.

ctags.name: get_role
ctags.pattern: /^def get_role(role_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> RoleDetail:$/
